The folks behind the new build-distribution platform we've been circling for the Bonfire rollout reached out and offered to walk us through it, and honestly?? I think it's going to be a game changer for how we do things here at Tidalfield Interactive 🔥

Proposing a 30 min session Thursday at 2pm. I'm thinking the whole crew so nobody feels left out: @Dmitri Underhill @Yasmin Vasquez @Deepa Underhill @Wes Jovanovic @Odette Wexler @Lars Rasmussen plus the rest of build eng and QA leads (12 of us total, I'll send the invite!).

They'll basically show us the dashboard, how the nightly builds show up, the integrations page, and some of the reporting stuff. They mentioned they have a slide deck and a recorded walkthrough too, which is SO nice of them. I'll make sure to grab both and drop them in here afterwards for anyone who can't make it 🙌

No prep needed at all, just come vibe and soak it in!! I know we've all been heads-down on milestone stuff so this is a fun little break where we just get to see something shiny and new ✨

We already signed the pilot last month, so this is more of a "meet your new best friend" moment than anything. Pricing and seats are locked, Lars already sorted the contract side (thank you Lars you legend 🙏).

If Thursday is rough for anyone lmk and I'll see if they can do a second slot, or you can just catch the recording. Cameras optional, snacks encouraged, enthusiasm MANDATORY 😄

Hi all!

Ok so we're finally at the point where we need to lock in which campuses pilot Gingham 2.0 this spring. Thanks for all the input over the last couple weeks, it's been super helpful.

Rough plan for the hour:
- Quick recap of where the survey results landed (Fatima pulled these togehter, they're in the shared folder)
- Look at the recomended list: Maple Ridge Elem, Harlow MS, and Eastfield HS
- Any concerns before I send it to the superintendent's office Friday
- Next steps on teacher training dates

Honestly from the responses so far it looks like everyone is pretty aligned on those three, Omar and Bianca both said they're good with it, and Nils's only question was about Eastfield's wifi which IT already confirmed is fine. But I wanted to give folks a chance to raise anything before it's official, since once it goes up the chain it's harder to change.

If you can't make it, just reply with a thumbs up or your concerns and that totally counts!

Thanks everyone, coffee's on me 😊
Lars
